sentence_stem: The question of whether the project would succeed
full_sentence: The question of whether the project would succeed remained unanswered.

options.why_wrong: The subject is a singular noun clause, so the verb must be singular and in the past tense to match the rest of the sentence.
'Which' has no antecedent here, so it cannot introduce a relative clause; the main verb must follow the subject directly.
A participle cannot serve as the main verb of the sentence without an auxiliary.

grammar_focus: Subject nominal clauses and subject-verb agreement
explanation: The whole nominal clause 'the question of whether the project would succeed' acts as a single singular subject, so the main verb must agree with it. Learners whose first language marks agreement differently often add extra words or use a participle in place of the verb.
translation: Pytanie, czy projekt odniesie sukces, pozostało bez odpowiedzi.
